text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 1012 September 22, 1976
AUTHORIZING THE PHILIPPINE CHARITY SWEEPSTAKES OFFICE TO HOLD A LOTTERY DRAW
ON FEBRUARY/MARCH 1977, AND EVERY YEAR THEREAFTER, EXCLUSIVELY TO FINANCE
THE VARIOUS PROJECTS OF THE POPULATION CENTER FOUNDATION, INC
WHEREAS, the Government is vigorously pursuing the population program to assure greater opportunity for
each Filipino to reach his full potential and to attain his individual dignity;
WHEREAS, the magnitude of the task requires collaboration and coordination between the Government and
private entities organized for the purpose of assisting in the implementation of the national population policy;
WHEREAS, the Population Center Foundation, Inc. as the primary grant-making institution of the private
sector, has initiated, sponsored, assisted and financed population programs and projects which have
contributed substantially to social reform and economic development; and
WHEREAS, the Population Center Foundation, Inc. merits assistance in carrying out its objectives;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby authorize the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office to hold in
February/March 1977, and every year thereafter, a lottery draw the proceeds of which shall, after deducting
the payment of the prizes and expenses, as provided in Republic Act No. 1169, be turned over the Population
Center Foundation, Inc. to constitute a special fund to help maintain and support its various ongoing projects
and to finance future similar projects.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
